provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) Storm Events Database

events.narrative: Severe pre-monsoon Nor'wester (Kalbaishakhi) squall downburst uprooted 60+ high-tension transmission towers and destroyed rooftop water cisterns across North Guwahati.
Intense squall line preceding cyclonic landfall brought localized 110mm/hr cloudburst causing flash urban flooding in low-lying coastal quarters.
